fullText.simplified:
变化

    现在，曹操已经四十八岁了，这些事情已经过去了。从什么时候开始，他和元少慢慢变了呢？曹操想了想，觉得是从最近这几年开始的。
    最近这几年，曹操的助手越来越多，军队也越来越多，他得到了很多地方。虽然他很厉害，但是北方和南方也有很厉害的人。厉害的人都想得到更多的地方，也想做最厉害的人。
    谁是最厉害的人？虽然每个人都说是自己，但是没有打过，谁又知道呢？所以，他们一直在打，今天你打我，明天我打你，国家很不安静。
    曹操也想做最厉害的人，他想打败所有人。他觉得如果打败了所有人，大家就会听他的话。如果大家都听他的话，他就是国家最重要的人了，国家就会变安静。
    曹操离北方近，他要先打北方，再打南方。北方最厉害的人是元少，曹操要打北方，就要打元少。
    元少和曹操一样，也想做最厉害的人，他要打南方。曹操在南方和北方中间，元少要打南方，第一个就要打曹操。
    从这个时候开始，他们就不是朋友了。
    是曹操变了？还是元少变了？这不好说，他们都变了，他们也都没有变。他们一直都是这样的人，他们想要的东西是一样的。所以，总有一天，他们都是要打仗的。
fullText.traditional:
變化

    現在，曹操已經四十八歲了，這些事情已經過去了。從什麼時候開始，他和元少慢慢變了呢？曹操想了想，覺得是從最近這幾年開始的。
    最近這幾年，曹操的助手越來越多，軍隊也越來越多，他得到了很多地方。雖然他很厲害，但是北方和南方也有很厲害的人。厲害的人都想得到更多的地方，也想做最厲害的人。
    誰是最厲害的人？雖然每個人都說是自己，但是沒有打過，誰又知道呢？所以，他們一直在打，今天你打我，明天我打你，國家很不安靜。
    曹操也想做最厲害的人，他想打敗所有人。他覺得如果打敗了所有人，大家就會聽他的話。如果大家都聽他的話，他就是國家最重要的人了，國家就會變安靜。
    曹操離北方近，他要先打北方，再打南方。北方最厲害的人是元少，曹操要打北方，就要打元少。
    元少和曹操一樣，也想做最厲害的人，他要打南方。曹操在南方和北方中間，元少要打南方，第一個就要打曹操。
    從這個時候開始，他們就不是朋友了。
    是曹操變了？還是元少變了？這不好說，他們都變了，他們也都沒有變。他們一直都是這樣的人，他們想要的東西是一樣的。所以，總有一天，他們都是要打仗的。

sentences.simplified: 现在，曹操已经四十八岁了，这些事情已经过去了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，曹操已經四十八歲了，這些事情已經過去了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài cáo cāo yǐ jīng sì shí bā suì le zhè xiē shì qing yǐ jīng guò qù le
sentences.english: Cao Cao was now 48 years old, and all these things had passed.

sentences.simplified: 从什么时候开始，他和元少慢慢变了呢？
sentences.traditional: 從什麼時候開始，他和元少慢慢變了呢？
sentences.pinyin: cóng shén me shí hou kāi shǐ tā hé yuán shào màn man biàn le ne
sentences.english: When did it start to slowly change between him and Yuan Shao?

sentences.simplified: 曹操想了想，觉得是从最近这几年开始的。
sentences.traditional: 曹操想了想，覺得是從最近這幾年開始的。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo xiǎng le xiǎng jué de shì cóng zuì jìn zhè jǐ nián kāi shǐ de
sentences.english: Cao Cao thought about it and felt that it started in the last few years.

sentences.simplified: 最近这几年，曹操的助手越来越多，军队也越来越多，他得到了很多地方。
sentences.traditional: 最近這幾年，曹操的助手越來越多，軍隊也越來越多，他得到了很多地方。
sentences.pinyin: zuì jìn zhè jǐ nián cáo cāo de zhù shǒu yuè lái yuè duō jūn duì yě yuè lái yuè duō tā dé dào le hěn duō dì fang
sentences.english: In the last few years, Cao Cao had more and more assistants and more and more troops, and he gained a lot of territory.

sentences.simplified: 虽然他很厉害，但是北方和南方也有很厉害的人。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他很厲害，但是北方和南方也有很厲害的人。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā hěn lì hai dàn shì běi fāng hé nán fāng yě yǒu hěn lì hai de rén
sentences.english: Although he was formidable, there were formidable people in the north and south as well.

sentences.simplified: 厉害的人都想得到更多的地方，也想做最厉害的人。
sentences.traditional: 厲害的人都想得到更多的地方，也想做最厲害的人。
sentences.pinyin: lì hai de rén dōu xiǎng dé dào gèng duō de dì fang yě xiǎng zuò zuì lì hai de rén
sentences.english: Formidable people all want to get more territory and want to be the most formidable.

sentences.simplified: 谁是最厉害的人？虽然每个人都说是自己，但是没有打过，谁又知道呢？
sentences.traditional: 誰是最厲害的人？雖然每個人都說是自己，但是沒有打過，誰又知道呢？
sentences.pinyin: shéi shì zuì lì hai de rén suī rán měi ge rén dōu shuō shì zì jǐ dàn shì méi yǒu dǎ guò shéi yòu zhī dào ne
sentences.english: Who was the most formidable person? Although everyone claimed it was them, no one had been beaten. Who knows?

sentences.simplified: 所以，他们一直在打，今天你打我，明天我打你，国家很不安静。
sentences.traditional: 所以，他們一直在打，今天你打我，明天我打你，國家很不安靜。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā men yì zhí zài dǎ jīn tiān nǐ dǎ wǒ míng tiān wǒ dǎ nǐ guó jiā hěn bù ān jìng
sentences.english: Therefore, they were always fighting. You fight me one day, I fight you the next day. The country was not peaceful.

sentences.simplified: 曹操也想做最厉害的人，他想打败所有人。
sentences.traditional: 曹操也想做最厲害的人，他想打敗所有人。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo yě xiǎng zuò zuì lì hai de rén tā xiǎng dǎ bài suǒ yǒu rén
sentences.english: Cao Cao also wanted to be the most formidable person. He wanted to defeat everyone.

sentences.simplified: 他觉得如果打败了所有人，大家就会听他的话。
sentences.traditional: 他覺得如果打敗了所有人，大家就會聽他的話。
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de rú guǒ dǎ bài le suǒ yǒu rén dà jiā jiù huì tīng tā de huà
sentences.english: He thought that if he defeated everyone, everyone would do what he said.

sentences.simplified: 如果大家都听他的话，他就是国家最重要的人了，国家就会变安静。
sentences.traditional: 如果大家都聽他的話，他就是國家最重要的人了，國家就會變安靜。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ dà jiā dōu tīng tā de huà tā jiù shì guó jiā zuì zhòng yào de rén le guó jiā jiù huì biàn ān jìng
sentences.english: If everyone did what he said, he would be the most important person in the country, and the country would be peaceful.

sentences.simplified: 曹操离北方近，他要先打北方，再打南方。
sentences.traditional: 曹操離北方近，他要先打北方，再打南方。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo lí běi fāng jìn tā yào xiān dǎ běi fāng zài dǎ nán fāng
sentences.english: Cao Cao was close to the north, so he must first fight the north and then fight the south.

sentences.simplified: 北方最厉害的人是元少，曹操要打北方，就要打元少。
sentences.traditional: 北方最厲害的人是元少，曹操要打北方，就要打元少。
sentences.pinyin: běi fāng zuì lì hai de rén shì yuán shào cáo cāo yào dǎ běi fāng jiù yào dǎ yuán shào
sentences.english: The most formidable person in the north was Yuan Shao. If Cao Cao wanted to fight the north, he must fight Yuan Shao.

sentences.simplified: 元少和曹操一样，也想做最厉害的人，他要打南方。
sentences.traditional: 元少和曹操一樣，也想做最厲害的人，他要打南方。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào hé cáo cāo yí yàng yě xiǎng zuò zuì lì hai de rén tā yào dǎ nán fāng
sentences.english: Like Cao Cao, Yuan Shao wanted to be the most formidable person. He wanted to fight in the south.

sentences.simplified: 曹操在南方和北方中间，
sentences.traditional: 曹操在南方和北方中間，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo zài nán fāng hé běi fāng zhōng jiān
sentences.english: Cao Cao was between the south and the north.

sentences.simplified: 元少要打南方，第一个就要打曹操。
sentences.traditional: 元少要打南方，第一個就要打曹操。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào yào dǎ nán fāng dì yī ge jiù yào dǎ cáo cāo
sentences.english: If Yuan Shao wanted to fight in the south, Cao Cao was the first person he had to fight.

sentences.simplified: 从这个时候开始，他们就不是朋友了。
sentences.traditional: 從這個時候開始，他們就不是朋友了。
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhè ge shí hou kāi shǐ tā men jiù bú shì péng you le
sentences.english: From this moment on, they were no longer friends.

sentences.simplified: 是曹操变了？还是元少变了？这不好说，他们都变了，他们也都没有变。
sentences.traditional: 是曹操變了？還是元少變了？這不好說，他們都變了，他們也都沒有變。
sentences.pinyin: shì cáo cāo biàn le hái shi yuán shào biàn le zhè bù hǎo shuō tā men dōu biàn le tā men yě dōu méi yǒu biàn
sentences.english: Did Cao Cao change? Or did Yuan Shao change? It’s hard to say. They had both changed and not changed.

sentences.simplified: 他们一直都是这样的人，他们想要的东西是一样的。
sentences.traditional: 他們一直都是這樣的人，他們想要的東西是一樣的。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì zhí dōu shì zhè yàng de rén tā men xiǎng yào de dōng xi shì yí yàng de
sentences.english: They had always been like this, and they wanted the same things.

sentences.simplified: 所以，总有一天，他们都是要打仗的。
sentences.traditional: 所以，總有一天，他們都是要打仗的。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ zǒng yǒu yì tiān tā men dōu shì yào dǎ zhàng de
sentences.english: Therefore, the day would inevitably come when they would go to battle.

sentence_translations: Change
Cao Cao was now 48 years old, and all these things had passed.
When did it start to slowly change between him and Yuan Shao?
Cao Cao thought about it and felt that it started in the last few years.
In the last few years, Cao Cao had more and more assistants and more and more troops, and he gained a lot of territory.
Although he was formidable, there were formidable people in the north and south as well.
Formidable people all want to get more territory and want to be the most formidable.
Who was the most formidable person? Although everyone claimed it was them, no one had been beaten. Who knows?
Therefore, they were always fighting. You fight me one day, I fight you the next day. The country was not peaceful.
Cao Cao also wanted to be the most formidable person. He wanted to defeat everyone.
He thought that if he defeated everyone, everyone would do what he said.
If everyone did what he said, he would be the most important person in the country, and the country would be peaceful.
Cao Cao was close to the north, so he must first fight the north and then fight the south.
The most formidable person in the north was Yuan Shao. If Cao Cao wanted to fight the north, he must fight Yuan Shao.
Like Cao Cao, Yuan Shao wanted to be the most formidable person. He wanted to fight in the south.
Cao Cao was between the south and the north.
If Yuan Shao wanted to fight in the south, Cao Cao was the first person he had to fight.
From this moment on, they were no longer friends.
Did Cao Cao change? Or did Yuan Shao change? It’s hard to say. They had both changed and not changed.
They had always been like this, and they wanted the same things.
Therefore, the day would inevitably come when they would go to battle.
